messages:
tara_sales: Quick sync — Greystream POC asking for 40% off hosted API + private deploy add-on. They want a 3mo pilot, potential to convert to Dedicated quarterly commit. Can we approve a bespoke rate?

julie_dealdesk: Need margin calc and ACV if converted. what does 40% look like vs price floor?

samir_eng: FYI the private deploy adds ~2x infra cost for short pilots (onboarding + infra). ops note: timeline ~2 weeks for VPC setup.

ben_finance: 40% seems aggressive. what's their expected monthly usage tokens? need to ensure we don't go below price floor. Please share numbers.

lara: @tara_sales did you mean 40% off list or 40% off our negotiated POC SKU? big difference.

lara is not in participants: (mistake)

tara_sales: sorry typo — 40% off list. Expected pilot usage ~1.2B tokens total over 3 months (~400M/mo). If they convert to Dedicated we expect 20M requests/mo steady state (estimate).

julie_dealdesk: Send me the simple calc. I need: list price, 40% price, cost estimate (infra + support), and annualized ARR if converted. I can route to pricing leads.

ben_finance: rough calc from my side: list = $0.0006/token => list pilot = $720k over 3mo. 40% off => $432k. Infra+support estimated cost ~ $120k for pilot (higher because private deploy). Margin ~30% before enterprise credits. That’s borderline but maybe OK if conversion probability high.

lina_csm: Greystream is strategic — finance team already indicated potential $1.8M ARR if they go Dedicated within 6mo. CSMs will support evals and security paperwork.

mike_secssg: Security question: they insist on SOC2 + custom DPA + encryption key in customer KMS. SOC2 is fine; KMS passthrough for Private is supported but needs ops timeline. DPA usually OK but legal needs heads-up. No showstoppers.

julie_dealdesk: OK. Two asks for approval thread: 1) approve 40% off list for a 3mo POC (one-time, non-recoupable). 2) commit path: if they convert to Dedicated within 6mo, offer to transition to 12mo reserved at 15% off list (standard) — we can include convertible credit equal to 25% of pilot spend applied to first invoice. Thoughts?

samir_eng: Technical caveat: if they use long context models, token cost spikes. Need config in SOW to cap model sizes or include overage terms.

ben_finance: I can sign off if (a) legal approves DPA/KMS, (b) conversion trigger and 25% credit caps at pilot spend and (c) price floor for Dedicated >= 70% of list.

mike_secssg: Legal and Sec agree on DPA + KMS, but require SLA exceptions documented for on-prem cases. Add to SOW.

julie_dealdesk: I'll draft the approval note for Deal Desk: include numbers, margin calc, tech caveats, security signoffs, and convertible credit term. Sending draft in a few hours. :white_check_mark:

tara_sales: thanks — please @julie_dealdesk me when sent. Greystream wants a decision by EOD tomorrow.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: created ticket OPS-4127 for VPC onboarding; ETA 2 weeks.

julie_dealdesk: Draft sent to deal-desk channel and legal. tagging @ben_finance @mike_secssg for formal thumbs.

ben_finance: thumbs up from finance pending legal DPA signoff.

mike_secssg: thumbs up from sec once DPA + SLA amendment are in SOW.

julie_dealdesk: decision: provisional approval for 40% off list for 3mo POC, convertible credit = 25% of pilot spend applied to first Dedicated invoice, Dedicated conversion price floor = 70% of list, security/legal signoffs required. I'll file final approval doc.

tara_sales: great — I'll update customer and push SOW. :rocket:
